title: RTT/Inside Substrate Coherence Envelope Schema
description: Defines coherence envelope metadata for RTT/Inside enterprise identity substrates.

coherence_envelope.description: The boundary within which identity and service metadata remain coherent and stable.

coherence_origin.description: Identity substrate layer that asserted or inferred the coherence envelope.

coherence_strength.description: Strength of coherence within the envelope, representing stability and predictability of identity metadata.

coherence_timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the coherence envelope was generated or last updated.
